title: DerivedCohomologyGermIso
statement: For every scheme S, geometric point s, L in D⁺(Ab(S_et)) and integer n, the canonical comparison from derived sections to sections of H^n(L) [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs] induces an isomorphism on geometric stalks. This is the sheafification comparison and has no strict-local continuity or mate assertion.

source.place: Tags 03Q9, 03Q8 and 0BKV; neighbourhood colimit and final injective-complex paragraph

proof.text: Use the free-sheaf/sections adjunction to identify morphisms from ℤ[U] with sections. Represent L[n] by a bounded below complex of injectives, using the cited injective-representative lemma. Cycles surject locally onto homology, so every homology section locally comes from a chain map out of the single free sheaf. A class mapping to zero locally lifts through the degree -1 differential; the corresponding single-complex map is null-homotopic, hence zero in the derived category. Transport both local properties through the representative isomorphism. Postcompose with the homology shift isomorphism. The resulting map is locally bijective, hence lies in the sheafification equivalences W. Mathlib Point.W_isInvertedBy_presheafFiber then makes its canonical geometric stalk map an isomorphism. This uses the skyscraper adjunction and requires no local-smallness assumption on the full small-etale category. All these arguments are implemented by proved private helpers; no new statement is left unproved.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about structure-sheaf stalks and ordinary module pullback; none realizes these abelian derived-section maps. Loogle presheafToSheaf, homology and IsPullback, IsAffineHom queries returned no hits.

Mathlib has general stalk and pullback infrastructure, but no strict-local derived mate or the canonical derived Hom-to-germ comparison. The existing AbelianHigherDirectImagePresheaf has private definitions of the comparison, inaccessible from another module.
